Name: Stack Split Redux
Author: pepoluan
TagLine: Shift+RightClick now allows you to set the stack size!
Description:
This mod enhances Shift+RightClick to just halve your stack, but you can also specify the size!

Applies not just to your inventory, but also:
 * Crafting items
 * Buying from shops (including Desert Trader & Island Trader)
 * Selling to shops
 * CJB Item Spawner
 * ... and others that I cannot remember ...

For more info, go check [**Stack Split Redux's page on Nexus**](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8967)
